doc.title: John Best interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998

title: Who said all you can drink for a dollar
summary: Sorting out who said the Holiday Inn happy hour line.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: I wanted to ask you about one thing that I read in a book by Bill Crow. It has jazz stories in it. And it said something about you guys were at a Holiday Inn somewhere and it had a © Fillius Jazz Archive -17-
sign, Happy Hour All You Can Drink for a Dollar. Do you remember this thing? Do you remember what you said?
Somebody said “give me two dollars’ worth?” Right? All you can drink for a dollar, give me two dollars worth?
I think Billy Butterfield is who said this.
But Crosby, I think he blamed me on that.
Well I always like to check on these stories you know, because sometimes they don’t come out exactly right when people print them.
But I will confess, it’s not mine originally.
I got blamed for that. And I heard it was Billy.
